verdict.rationale: The only direct evidence of AI triage is the founder's HN description of Zero as an AI-powered email client that auto-categorizes threads. The MCP label-modification and label-creation tools are building blocks for an external agent, not built-in triage, so they earn no credit here. missing for 10: documented auto-labeling behavior, surfacing of what needs attention, user controls to steer categorization rules, audit trail or explanation of AI triage decisions, first-party docs and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, AI triages my inbox for me — auto-labeling, categorizing, and surfacing what needs attention — with behavior I can steer and audit

citations.quote: Zero founder describes it as an AI-powered email client that auto-categorizes, summarizes threads, drafts replies
